customer_message.subject: chat – mould + heating, Solothurn
customer_message.body:
Harriet Okafor: Hello, I'm a tenant of Wohnwerk Thur GmbH at Rebbergstrasse 39 in Solothurn, 4 rooms
Harriet Okafor: there's mould growing behind my wardrobe and now along the bedroom ceiling. and the underfloor heating in the living area stopped working completely
Harriet Okafor: I reported both in June, letter attached. nothing happened
Harriet Okafor: I have asthma and I've had more attacks this summer than in the last 5 years together, the mould in the bedroom doesn't help
Harriet Okafor: I've decided I'm going to pay my rent into the official rent deposit from next month until they repair things. can you help me do that properly? what do I need to send them first?
